messages:
anna-sec: Quick sync — we need cross-team signoff on the event ontology mapping before next week's release. Proposed anchor: use urn:redwood:event:<action>:<subject> and a separate consumer_label for UI/SDK. Thoughts?

mike-plat: +1 on URN. Can we add a version token like :v1 at the end? helps staged rollouts and backcompat.

ravi-privacy: prefer not to expose internal actor IDs in customer-facing labels. consumer_label should be safe-for-public and not contain principals.

sasha-prodeng: How does this interact with the RBAC changes we planned (service_impersonation + scoped grants)? we need actor_type in events so ops can evaluate who initiated.

anna-sec: Agreed — include actor_type as an internal enum (user, service, system). Keep consumer_label and urn stable. actor_id can be present but flagged pii=true for redaction rules.

mike-plat: Example payload suggestion so teams can see how fields map:
```json
{
  "urn": "urn:redwood:event:model.deploy:update:v1",
  "actor_type": "service",
  "actor_id": "svc-123",
  "resource": {"type": "model", "id": "m-abc"},
  "consumer_label": "Model updated",
  "severity": "info",
  "provenance": {"request_id": "req-987"},
  "pii_redaction": "partial"
}
```

jules: For docs/console we want short, friendly labels like "Model updated" (not the URN). Product will map URN -> label. Good to keep that mapping documented.

ravi-privacy: Also request a field redaction_level: {none, partial, full} so downstream exporters know how to sanitize for logs and customer exports.

anna-sec: Action items (from thread):
- mike-plat: add urn/versioning guidelines + SIEM mapping examples to the spec (due Fri)
- sasha-prodeng: draft RBAC actor_type enum + implications for event consumers (due Tue)
- ravi-privacy: produce privacy/redaction guidance and examples (due Thu)
- jules: confirm consumer_label UX constraints for docs/console (due Wed)

mike-plat: I'll also sketch a fluentd/splunk mapping and a sample ingestion pipeline so infra can onboard quickly.

audit-bot: New spec PR opened by @mike-plat: https://git.internal/r/redwood/specs/+/234 — CI:tests passed :white_check_mark: 

sasha-prodeng: Quick sync call at 15:00 PT today to get final alignment. who can join?

jules: I can.

ravi-privacy: I might be 10m late.

anna-sec: I'll be on. Added meeting to calendar. :calendar: Feel free to drop any pre-reads or sample event lists here before the call.
